r: Provide e-mail and phone advice to vessels on all problems concerning onboard computer systems, hardware and software, analyzing specific problems and suggesting corrective actions.
Provide solutions to Fleet and SHEQ divisions as per IMO and class of registry’s rules and regulations to meet charterers demand.
Monitor fleet applications and relevant servers for seamless data transmission to and from the vessel and office.
Provide technical support and liaise with service providers for radio communication equipment onboard.
Provide technical support to vessels audio, video and entertainment system.
Configure Interface among vessels IT network and engine vibrations systems as required by business requirements to obtain vessels best performance.
Coordinate with the vendor support to resolve technical problems with desktop computing equipment, printers and software.
Support the testing, configuration, purchase, supply and installation of replacement on board computer hardware and software to ensure safe and efficient vessel operation.
Test single units of any third-party software destined for vessels to ensure successful integration into the existing on-board software prior to fleet-wide procurement.

Ensure all vessels computers maintain current version of anti-virus software and supply upgrades of anti-virus software. Also, ensure all vessels computers are running licensed software and that there are no copyright infringements.
Ensure the repairs are completed efficiently and cost-effectively taking into account the severity of the fault and the vessel’s voyage pattern when repairs are requiring a visit to the vessel.
Prepare and present weekly update to the Fleet IT Team Lead regarding all relevant Fleet IT Tasks.
Ensure network connectivity inside vessels, that includes activating network points, and patch panels. Also, wireless connectivity of all provided SSIDs.
Assist in administering the software program that links between data files from vessels and the office-based data processing programs. Advice vessels on any data errors and suggest corrective actions
Perform all activities related to Asset’s management such as registration, tagging, preventive maintenance, licenses and usage.
Obtain various recommended patches for operating systems, databases, Softwares and apply them to all the systems on timely basis to ensure optimum performance.

Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
Implement approved policies, processes and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.

d: We are seeking an experienced and qualified IT Specialist to join our team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting the company's IT infrastructure across all branches, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT operations. The role involves providing technical support to employees across all company locations, maintaining network systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring smooth IT operations throughout the organization.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT support and administration.
Strong knowledge of computer systems, networks, hardware, software, and troubleshooting.
Ability to provide technical support across all company branches.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
r: Provide IT support and technical assistance to all company branches.
Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computer hardware, software, and IT systems.
Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, routers, switches, and wireless networks.
Ensure regular system updates, data backups, and IT maintenance.
Manage user accounts, access permissions, and IT security.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues.
Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers when required.
Support and maintain business and engineering-related software applications.
Ensure the security, reliability, and efficiency of IT systems across all branches.
Maintain accurate IT documentation and technical records.
